src: data as of Nov 3, ~09:00 UTC · sources: The Block, Binance, Strategy 8-K, Bitmine, Circle, KuCoin · not financial advice

beats.say: Three point six four billion dollars left Binance in under ten hours after it reopened withdrawals.
beats.cap: $3.64B left Binance in under 10 hours after it reopened withdrawals.

beats.say: Binance says it has refilled about ninety-five percent of the stolen assets, and published a new proof of reserves.
beats.cap: Binance says it refilled ~95% of stolen assets and published a new proof of reserves.

beats.say: Big buyers didn't flinch. Strategy bought eight hundred eleven bitcoin for sixty-five point five million.
beats.cap: Big buyers didn't flinch. Strategy bought 811 BTC for $65.5M.

beats.say: Bitmine added eight thousand five hundred seventy-three ether. Tom Lee called the muted hack reaction very constructive.
beats.cap: Bitmine added 8,573 ETH. Tom Lee called the muted hack reaction "very constructive."
beats.text: Bitmine adds ether, now 4.9% of supply

beats.say: Why it matters: exchange risk is back, but treasuries kept buying. Next up: Block earnings today, Circle on Wednesday.
beats.cap: Exchange risk is back, but treasuries kept buying. Next: Block earnings today, Circle on Wednesday.

title: $3.64B left Binance in 10 hours. Strategy and Bitmine kept buying anyway
caption:
deal flow after the binance hack 🏦 $3.64b left binance in the first 9.5 hours after withdrawals reopened, binance says ~95% of stolen assets are refilled, strategy bought 811 btc and bitmine added 8,573 eth. block reports today, circle on wednesday. would you keep funds on an exchange right now? 👇 not financial advice.
